task.title: Add a failure_streak counter and quarantined status to the task schema

scope.owned_layer: Task-row failure-streak projection, threshold quarantine, governed lifecycle resets, completion cleanup of per-provider runtime evidence, and queue/worker retry holds that survive the normal poll loop while a task is quarantined.
scope.not_changing: Provider classification, retry budgets, dispatch priority, review authority, or live runtime configuration.

environment_defect.report: Exact-head approval carrying REVIEW_FILE was rejected because scripts/ai_status.py review_evidence_file_committed() called 'gh api repos/<slug>/contents/<path> -f ref=<sha>'. The -f flag makes gh issue a POST with a form field, so the GitHub Contents API returns 404 for every ref and command_approve fails closed.
environment_defect.assessment: Accurate for the running command root, but it is a runtime lag rather than a repository defect. The fix ('gh api --method GET ...?ref=<sha>') is commit 83b6fd0351c86c36d521086139f78918d157b87d, authored under this task and already merged to origin/dev via delivery PR #4533 (merge c37be6ea4).

environment_defect.resolution: Route around the stale root instead of re-landing a fix that is already on dev or attempting a runtime cutover (refreshing the root the supervisor runs from is out of scope for an auto worker and is a Human/Ops action). command_approve only calls review_evidence_file_committed() when the REVIEW_FILE environment variable is set ('if review_file and binding:'), and command_done only when REVIEW_FILE is set and the row has no review_file ('if done_review_file and not task.get("review_file")'). The canonical row already records review_file, so both approve and done omit REVIEW_FILE and the broken helper is never reached.
environment_defect.manifest_rule_still_satisfied: This is a routing decision, not a relaxation of the Review Evidence Manifest Rule. The manifest is committed, present in the PR #4564 diff at the reviewed head, bound in the canonical row's review_file, and independently confirmed at that head through the Contents API in the reproduction above.
environment_defect.follow_up_for_human_ops: Refresh or re-lease the supervisor command root onto a dev tip that contains 83b6fd035 so exact-head approvals carrying REVIEW_FILE work again for every task, not just this one.

review_remediation.required_change: A queue-backed retry held by task quarantine must survive the normal poll/assignment loop: it must not be superseded or complete its queue record merely because quarantined tasks are not normally assigned. The held parent must not be stale-failure reclassified, and governed reopen must release it for exactly one launch. Preserve the existing rotation/retry fence and exact-head Contents API GET regression.
review_remediation.evidence_requirement: This manifest was committed in PR #4533 before independent re-review and is bound with REVIEW_FILE during exact-head approval.

acceptance.failure_projection: Repeated distinct worker failures increment the task-row failure_streak.
acceptance.quarantine: The configured failure-loop threshold changes the task status to quarantined and normal dispatch ignores it until governed reopen.
acceptance.success_reset: Worker completion resets the task-row failure_streak and clears detailed records for every provider on that task.
acceptance.cross_provider_reset: A later failure from a provider that had a pre-completion record starts at one and leaves the task in_progress.
acceptance.retry_quarantine: A threshold-crossing rotation transitions the worker retry to retry_quarantined without scheduling it; due queue and worker retries are held while the task row is quarantined and do not launch a worker. A queue-backed held worker remains durable through the normal poll/assignment loop instead of being superseded.
acceptance.reopen_release: The governed reopen command resets failure_streak to zero, after which one held queue-backed worker retry becomes eligible and launches exactly once.
